verdict.rationale: Kong documents an official Konnect MCP Server (kong-docs-66, kong-probe-3), so AI agents in an MCP client can plausibly drive Konnect conversationally. That is a first-party route to natural-language operation, but the evidence gives only a page title and never describes the operations exposed or how natural-language commands work. No built-in natural-language assistant or command interface is documented in Kong itself. missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface or assistant in Konnect/Kong Manager, documentation of which operations the MCP server exposes for conversational control, hands-on or independent corroboration.
